The '''Evil Chicken's Lair''' is located on [[Zanaris]]{{CiteNPC|npc=Konar quo Maten|quote=The Evil Chicken's Lair is located on the moon of Zanaris. |loc=|notes=|name=}} and is accessed by using a [[raw chicken]] on the [[Chicken Shrine]]. [[Raw chicken (undead)|Undead raw chicken]] does not work.

It is accessible during and after the [[Recipe for Disaster]] subquest [[Freeing Sir Amik Varze]] during which players must kill the [[Evil Chicken (Recipe for Disaster)|Evil Chicken]]. To be able to access the Evil Chicken's Lair, the player must have spoken to the [[Wise Old Man]] in [[Draynor Village]] after speaking to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]] to learn [[Sir Amik Varze]]'s recipe.

The area can be exited via the [[portal (Evil Chicken Lair)|portal]], which takes you next to the chicken shrine.

==Monsters==
Four level 227 [[black dragon]]s live here on the main level, making the lair an ideal location for [[Slayer task]]s, due to the proximity of the [[Zanaris]] bank. Before entering, players are suggested to wield an [[anti-dragon shield]] and turn on the [[Protect from Melee]] [[prayer]], as the black dragons are close to the portal and will attack on entry. A [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]] can be placed in the lair. 

Black dragons can be [[Safespot|safespotted]] in the entrance of eastern tunnel to the mine, or north using the bone piles before the cave with the evil chicken nest. Once the dragons become [[Tolerance|non-aggressive]], they can also be safespotted using the south-west corner of the middle pillar.

A level 83 [[baby black dragon]] can be found down a level and is reached by using a [[rope]] on the tunnel entrance near the middle of the west wall, and then climbing down the rope. The rope will last for a few minutes, then disappear, requiring the player to bring a rope every trip.

==Mine==
{{main|Evil Chicken's Lair mine}}
A mine in the south-east ([[Evil Chicken's Lair mine]]) has 4 [[Iron rocks|iron]], 4 [[Coal rocks|coal]], 3 [[Silver rocks|silver]], 4 [[Gold rocks|gold]], and 2 [[Mithril rocks|mithril]] rocks.

==Personalities==
*The [[Evil Chicken (Recipe for Disaster)|Evil Chicken]]
*[[K'klik]]

==Trivia==
*Using an [[egg]] on the Evil Chicken's shrine will give the message, "Nice idea, but nothing interesting happens".
*According to the [[Wise Old Man]], the reason that [[black dragon]]s can be found in the Evil Chicken's Lair is because it is forcing them to guard it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Wise Old Man|quote=(...) it's claimed that the chicken has forced some very powerful creatures to guard his lair.|loc=Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze|notes=|name=}}
